School of Software Engineering · Huazhong University of Science and Technology

Foundation Models & AI Agents

Second-year undergraduate courses · Spring semester

Study the principles behind models that process language and images, then build an agent that uses models, tools, and evidence to complete a task.

The two courses share a learning sequence: representations → Transformers → language and vision models → LLM agents. Each theory lesson connects to a practical exercise and a project deliverable.

Course 01 · Theory

Core Principles & Frontier Applications of Large Models

Representations, attention, Transformer blocks, language and vision models, adaptation, and agent principles.

Course 02 · Practice

Large Models & AI Agents: Project Design

Individual experiments followed by a team project that combines perception, retrieval, tool use, and evaluation.

LessonTheoryProject preparation

Teaching allocation: foundations and evaluation 8h · Transformer core 12h · visual generation and multimodal learning 4h · LLM agents 8h.

Course design projects

Teams of about three

Complete the individual experiments during the semester. Use the two-week project course to integrate components and evaluate one application.
